meta.name: harness-audit
meta.description: Audit and harden a repository's AI coding agent harness across the 6 Software Factory Stations (Intent, Harness, Loop, Graph, Verification, Release) and place it on the Autonomy Ladder (Level 0–5). Use when you need to: (1) audit a repo's readiness for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor using `@wondelai/harness-audit` or manual inspection, (2) diagnose why agents drift, loop, break tests, or stall in PR review, (3) fix duplicated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, broken MCP configs, retired Codex settings, unguarded Stop hooks, or weak test oracles, (4) generate a verified remediation plan or scaffold starter harness files safely, or (5) climb from Level 2 paired prompting to Level 3–4 spec-driven verified loops.
